title: The portal invoice shows the no-charge line at $0.00 with its category
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Make sure the Internal Work Orders setting is on in Settings > Work Orders.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A.
  • Have a portal contact for this test for customer A, whose portal login and email the tester can use.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced, billable, whose line 2 was No Charge under Goodwill.
custom_steps:
1. Sign in to the customer portal as customer A's contact.
  2. Open work order 1's invoice in the portal.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The portal opens.

Step 2:

  • Line 2 shows $0.00 with "Goodwill" under its title; there is no stamp and no badge.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Internal Work Orders (PRD)", Confluence 942243841, version 1.0 final (9 Nov 2026, Milos Vasic), read 12 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-11665, story SV-12226 (Story 12, A no-charge line on a billable work order), story SV-12296 (Story 12 (portal), The no-charge line in the customer portal)

  • S12-R7: “Create invoice works as today. The invoice (preview, PDF, email, portal) shows the no-charge line with its hours and parts at $0.00 and the category name as a line under the title ("Warranty"); no stamp, no badge, no "No Charge" wording elsewhere on the document. The invoice statement of the line is priced 0 and flagged no_charge with the category and the original work order, line and technician, the way a declined line's statement is priced 0 today; its items are priced 0. The statement keeps the line's hours and labour rate for the record.”
